topic: New pigment discovery versus new human colors

gaps.title: Auditable definition of practical pigment novelty
gaps.problem: Color claims mix new composition, changed spectrum, CIE separation, and commercial novelty.
gaps.research_need: Define reference-set, spectrum, multi-illuminant, and decision-rule criteria before screening.

gaps.title: Multiobjective pigment frontier
gaps.problem: Visual metrics alone cannot establish utility or responsible material choice.
gaps.research_need: Jointly rank color, spectral functionality, uncertainty, composition constraints, and stability proxies.

gaps.title: Validated structure-to-reflectance benchmark
gaps.problem: The project lacks an audited benchmark joining structural descriptors to full spectra for a targeted pigment class.
gaps.research_need: Build a documented reference set and evaluate out-of-distribution uncertainty.

gaps.title: Prediction-to-discovery reporting boundary
gaps.problem: Predicted candidates are often rhetorically conflated with measured or commercial pigments.
gaps.research_need: Use explicit candidate states and preregistered claim language.
